review:
An Egyptian 5x4 with pharaohs, snakes and birds. Wilds help complete wins, and Pragmatic describes it as highly volatile.

The provider's page and the game's own screens give different max win figures, so we don't list one yet. The official description doesn't explain the bonus in detail either – the demo is the best place to see how it works. A straightforward Egyptian game on a taller grid. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
